Card Q&A.a: The player who controls this card chooses.
Card Q&A.q: Which player chooses the Digimon to suspend with this card's skill?

I have this card in the battle area, and it's unsuspended. If one of my opponent's Digimon attacks a player and another effect suspends this card before its [Opponent's Turn] effect activates, can I then activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect?

This card is in the battle area, and it's suspended. If one of my opponent's Digimon attacks a player and another effect unsuspends this card before its [Opponent's Turn] effect activates, can I then activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect?

Effect: [Opponent's Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks a player, if this Digimon is suspended, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
